column3: Private IP Disclosure: false positive, the host input placeholder in index.html shows an example address (192.168.1.1)
Suspicious Comments: reviewed, script.js comments are plain descriptions with no sensitive information
Storable and Cacheable Content: only public static content; /api/* responses are sent with Cache-Control: no-store
Sec-Fetch-* headers missing: informational, concerns the scanner's own requests, not the server
Server header leaks version: tracked, to be fixed when the dev server is replaced by a production WSGI server
